3195.title: Mobile hierarchy disclosure has an undersized adjacent target
3195.rootCauseOneLine: The shared disclosure is fixed at 20px while a flex-1 navigation link immediately precedes it in a gapless 60px mobile row.
3195.proposedFix: Allow a caller size override, use a 44px target in the mobile recent-thread row, and add a neutral gap while preserving the 12px chevron glyph.
3195.caveats: Verified in Chrome mobile emulation rather than iOS Safari hardware; absolute coordinates differ by fixture, while target size, row height, adjacency, and hit testing reproduced.
